event.location_text: MALACCA STRAIT Approximately 3 nm north of Pulau Batam, Indonesia, in the eastbound lane of the TSS. [SOMS] Indonesia 01° 14.50' N

sources.title: Piracy monthly report June 2024
sources.text: While underway, the bridge team sighted a suspicious boat on its port bow with very dim lighting. The ship altered its course to starboard to keep a safe distance from the boat. However, at a distance of about 1.5 miles, the boat suddenly started flashing lights and accelerated, making a desperate attempt to board the ship. The ship performed evasive manoeuvres to deter the boarding attempt, and immediately notified Singapore Vessel Traffic Information Service (VTIS) East. Upon sighting a RSN ship in the vicinity, the small boat aborted its attempt and moved away from the ship.
